identityDecision: IATP is Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power, a North American thermal-power joint venture and portfolio. It is not International-Matex Tank Terminals (IMTT). The task-71 census row combined the real IATP abbreviation, 50% stake and 2026 timing with unrelated IMTT sector, geography narrative and a now-dead ArcLight/IMTT URL.

currentTransactionDecision.statusRationale: InfraBridge's official announcement says the transaction was signed, remained subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions, and was expected to close in the second half of 2026. InfraBridge's current portfolio page still presents IATP as its 50/50 joint venture with Invenergy. HSR early termination was granted in April 2026, but that regulatory milestone is not evidence of legal closing. No closing announcement was identified through 2026-08-13.
